change_summary: 为 179 个 L3 技术点补充 475 条英文别名，使上游英文语料（arXiv 论文）可被抽取。补充前英文覆盖率仅 17%（242 个 L3 中 40 个有纯英文别名），识别不到的技术在共现分析中会看起来永远不共现，结论会被系统性扭曲。

visual understanding（视觉感知与理解）：also refers to human visual comprehension in cognitive science

perception system（感知认知(通用)）：Can refer to any system that involves sensing or perception, including biological or organisational systems.
Embodied Reasoning（具身推理与ECoT）："Embodied reasoning" can also appear in embodied cognition and philosophy of mind, not exclusively in robotic task planning.
memory mechanism（记忆机制）："Memory mechanism" can refer to biological memory mechanisms in neuroscience or to computer memory architectures.
memory system（记忆机制）：Can denote any memory system, including human memory, operating system memory management, or AI memory modules.
memory architecture（记忆机制）：Commonly used in computer engineering for hardware memory hierarchy; may not specifically refer to memory in task planning.

task decomposition（任务规划与分解）：Widely used in operations research and software engineering for breaking down tasks, not specific to embodied task planning.
plan decomposition（任务规划与分解）：Can refer to decomposing plans in classical AI planning, not necessarily in embodied or robotics contexts.
other task planning methods（细分方法与技术(其他)）：broad category label; may match various 'other methods' sections in different domains
collective intelligence（群体智能与协同）：may refer to human collective intelligence in social sciences

manipulation perception（操作感知与表示）：Also used in broader contexts of robot perception beyond dexterous manipulation.
manipulation representation（操作感知与表示）：May refer to general object or task representations for manipulation.
electronic skin（电子皮肤与柔性触觉）：Also refers to electronic skin devices for cosmetic or wellness applications.

active sensing（主动感知）：Also refers to biological active sensing in neuroscience.
